description: This script generates Vulkan API header and implementation files (api_gen.h and api_gen.cpp). It defines functions for creating dispatch tables, intercepting Vulkan functions, and generating code for Vulkan API function pointers, including handling extensions and function dispatching.

methods.name: gen_h
methods.description: Generates the api_gen.h header file for Vulkan API dispatch tables and function declarations.

methods.name: _define_extension_stub
methods.description: Creates stub functions for Vulkan extension functions that are not enabled.

methods.name: _is_intercepted
methods.description: Checks if a Vulkan function is intercepted by the API layer.

methods.name: _intercept_instance_proc_addr
methods.description: Generates code for intercepting vkGetInstanceProcAddr calls.

methods.name: _intercept_device_proc_addr
methods.description: Generates code for intercepting vkGetDeviceProcAddr calls.

methods.name: _api_dispatch
methods.description: Generates code to dispatch Vulkan API functions.

methods.name: gen_cpp
methods.description: Generates the api_gen.cpp implementation file for Vulkan API function dispatching and interception.
